VBO:0201289.summary: Companionship and water are favorites of Harry, a ten-year-old Sprocker whom Malcata Animal Association described enjoying walks, swims and sofa evenings. This Springer–Cocker Spaniel cross appears in Liza Leonard’s firsthand account of Patch and Rufus: Patch approached for attention, while Rufus was initially shy; both liked balls and running.
VBO:0201289.shortDescription: Malcata described Harry as a Sprocker who loved water, walks and sofa company; Patch and Rufus enjoyed balls and running.
